title: Set the VPN network
description: Change the VPN network of nethsec-controller, recreating the tun and restarting the controller

ovpn_network.description: VPN client network, it must be the first address of the network, like '172.20.16.0'. It must be equal to the current one, unless force is set

ovpn_netmask.description: VPN client netmask, from '255.255.240.0' (/20) to '255.255.255.0' (/24). It can only be widened, unless force is set

force.description: Skip the network and netmask checks and allow netmasks wider than /20, /24 is still the limit, units outside the new network must be removed and added again
